composition_subtypes.role: core DP: 2D state (segments, index) storing sets of achievable AND values; auxiliary DP for upper bounds

payload.core_composition_summary: DP with 2D state storing sets of achievable AND values per segment count and index, using precomputed upper bound DP for pruning.
payload.rationale: The solution primarily relies on dynamic programming (2D state) to compute the maximum AND result. The initial DFS is only a time-limited heuristic that does not affect the core DP logic; if it fails, DP solves the problem exactly. Thus the solution is essentially a single DP mechanism.
